title: Brexit Britain Ten Years On
author: Sukant Chandan
content:
Image by Habib Ayoade. Introduction: Understanding Brexit as a Colonial
Project Ten years ago, on June 23, 2016, the Brexit referendum delivered a
narrow victory for leaving the European Union. To truly understand Brexit in
2026, one must interrogate the foundational colonial nature of the English and
British state. Far from a sudden political rupture, […]
